newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Sydney Casino to build convention centre.
newsitem.headline: Sydney Casino to build convention centre.

text.p: Sydney Harbour Casino Holdings Ltd said on Friday that it would build a convention and banquet centre at its permanent complex which was due to open in December this year.
It did not release the construction costs.
The centre would be completed by the year 2000 with seating for 1,000 people.
United States casino operator Showboat Inc has a 25 percent stake in the Sydney casino, along with the management rights. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
